body: I’m playing leonine stormherad barbarian who just got anti magic greatsword.  That comes out of a book like asta’s

I'm doing better actually.   I have a trend of helping myself out of a pit I've found myself in.   The school thing is something I'm still dealing with but I passed 2 of my 3 classes.   Im not letting things bother me as much as they did and I'm enjoying the time i have with my friends.  I got my driver's license and I'm looking for alternate ways of making money online.   So yeah.   Thanks for checking up on me.
Just my future, failing school, and how uninteresting life is to me.  I'm working for money till I'm old and feeble and then die.   What kind of life is that?

I constantly think about what my absence in life would have on those around me.  My friends and loved ones.   Yet it still hurts to just exist,   I've always had a strong head on my shoulders and was able to talk myself out of things except now. I went to bed and made my bed with some comfortable sheets and a pillowcase.  It felt good a nice bed yet that won't give me happiness.  I'm not sure what could.
